_readme: Every Devanagari string that appears anywhere in the film. The build script
(npm run devanagari) shapes each one with HarfBuzz and commits the outlines
to public/dev/<key>.svg. Nothing here is rendered with a webfont at runtime.
IF YOU CHANGE A STRING HERE YOU MUST RE-RUN `npm run devanagari`.
Keys beginning with _ are ignored by the build script.
